FOR THEIR ROCK IS NOT AS OUR ROCK, AND OUR ENEMIES ARE JUDGES; FOR THEIR VINE IS OF THE VINE OF SODOM AND OF THE FIELDS OF GOMORRAH, THEIR GRAPES ARE GRAPES OF GALL, CLUSTERS OF BITTERNESS; THEIR WINE IS THE VENOM OF SERPENTS AND THE CRUEL POISON OF ASPS. claim_en: IS NOT THIS LAID UP IN STORE WITH ME, SEALED UP IN MY TREASURIES? VENGEANCE IS MINE AND RECOMPENSE, AT THE TIME THEIR FOOT SLIPS; FOR THE DAY OF THEIR CALAMITY IS NEAR AND THE THINGS TO COME UPON THEM MAKE HASTE. FOR THE LORD WILL JUDGE HIS PEOPLE AND REPENT HIMSELF FOR HIS SERVANTS, WHEN HE SEES THAT THEIR POWER IS GONE AND THERE IS NONE SHUT UP OR LEFT; AND HE WILL SAY: WHERE ARE THEIR GODS, THE ROCK IN WHOM THEY TRUSTED, WHO ATE THE FAT OF THEIR SACRIFICES AND DRANK THE WINE OF THEIR DRINK OFFERING? LET THEM RISE UP AND HELP YOU, LET THEM BE YOUR PROTECTION. The Sifrei (piskaot 324-328, twenty rows): THE CUP IN STORE — Psalm 75:9's drop drunk by the Flood, the Dispersion, Sodom, Pharaoh, Sisera, Sennacherib, Nebuchadnezzar, the golden cup mended and the earthen not (324:1), the deeds' fruit and both rewards deferred to the redemption (324:2-3); VENGEANCE IS MINE — Myself, not an angel nor a messenger (325:1), the fathers' deeds repaid (325:2), R. Yose's a fortiori on the calamity's nearness (325:3), haste for the nations and delay for Israel by the four kingdoms (325:4); THE LORD WILL JUDGE HIS PEOPLE — joy over the nations, regret over Israel by Genesis 6:7 (326:1 — the flood prologue's row reread), the seven signs of the hand gone: the captivity, the despair, the last coin, none to plead like Moses, Aaron, Phinehas, no helper (326:2-7); WHERE ARE THEIR GODS — of Israel and of the nations, the consuls and governors (327:1-2); the fat of their sacrifices — the army's provisions (328:1, THE MISPRINTED HEAD 32:35 for 32:38), THE WICKED TITUS in the Holy of Holies and the defective suffix (328:2), Moses' altar and the daily offering (328:3), THE NAME PROFANED PUNISHED AT ONCE (328:4). Onkelos: 'are not all their works revealed before Me, laid up in My treasuries', 'vengeance is Mine and I will repay at the time they go into exile', 'the LORD will judge the judgment of His people', 'when their strength is exhausted', 'where are their fears, the strong ones in whom they trusted, the fat of whose sacrifices they ate'. claim_en: SEE NOW THAT I, I AM HE, AND THERE IS NO GOD WITH ME; I KILL AND I MAKE ALIVE, I HAVE WOUNDED AND I HEAL, AND THERE IS NONE THAT DELIVERS OUT OF MY HAND; FOR I LIFT UP MY HAND TO HEAVEN AND SAY: AS I LIVE FOR EVER — IF I WHET MY GLITTERING SWORD AND MY HAND TAKE HOLD ON JUDGMENT, I WILL RENDER VENGEANCE TO MY ADVERSARIES AND RECOMPENSE THOSE WHO HATE ME; I WILL MAKE MY ARROWS DRUNK WITH BLOOD AND MY SWORD SHALL DEVOUR FLESH, WITH THE BLOOD OF THE SLAIN AND THE CAPTIVES, FROM THE HEAD OF THE LEADERS OF THE ENEMY. SING ALOUD, O NATIONS, OF HIS PEOPLE, FOR HE WILL AVENGE THE BLOOD OF HIS SERVANTS, RENDER VENGEANCE TO HIS ADVERSARIES, AND HIS LAND MAKES ATONEMENT FOR HIS PEOPLE. The Sifrei (piskaot 329-333, twenty-one rows): I, I AM HE — the two powers refuted (329:1), four hints of the resurrection, wound and healing in one (329:2-3), no father delivers a son nor brother a brother, the soul beyond ransom (329:4); THE HAND LIFTED — the world created by word and by oath, the governor's province (330:1-2); THE SWORD WHETTED swift as lightning yet holding judgment, two vengeances, the Cutheans (the Samaritans) and the sectarians (331:1-4); the arrows drunk and the sword devouring — others fed (Ezekiel 39, Isaiah 34), the slain and the captives, Nimrod and Abraham, Pharaoh's head (332:1-6); SING, O NATIONS — the nations trembling as at the Sea (333:1), heaven and earth and the trees and the fathers singing (333:2), blood and violence avenged (333:3), THE LAND ATONES — R. Meir, the Shema (hear, O Israel) twice daily and the holy tongue (333:4), THE SONG'S THREE TIMES AND TWO WORLDS (333:5). Onkelos: 'see now that I am He, I am He and there is no god beside Me', 'I kill and I make alive, I smote and I heal', 'I have prepared in heaven the house of My Shekhinah' for the lifted hand, 'if My sword is revealed twice as lightning', 'I will make My arrows drunk with blood', 'praise, O nations, His people'.
